host.notes: Rootless user/mount namespace and offline SwiftPM cache were used. Identifying physical prefixes were redacted.

commands.purpose: Reproduce and verify the source-built GNU Binutils 2.47 stage.
Build xtool through the fixed logical mount from the first physical and Swift prefixes.
Repeat the clean offline build from distinct physical and Swift prefixes.

commands.command: cmp <physical-a>/xtool/xtool <physical-b>/xtool/xtool; cmp <physical-a>/xtool/libXADI.so <physical-b>/xtool/libXADI.so; env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH <each>/xtool --version; env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH <each>/xtool --help
commands.purpose: Require complete byte identity and run post-hash runtime checks.

expectedBehavior: Distinct physical scratch and Swift prefixes converge through one fixed logical build path and pinned GNU tools without rewriting .rodata or bypassing complete-file hashes.
observedBehavior: Both clean offline builds produced identical final xtool and XADI bytes and identical static ELF metadata. Neither physical prefix was present. xtool reported the exact revision and both --version and --help succeeded with LD_LIBRARY_PATH unset after complete candidate-hash agreement. Independent Binutils source builds also produced identical staged tools.
limitations: Qualification covers the private Linux x86-64 xtool build and reuse boundary only; it does not independently requalify signing, deployment, launch, device runtime, Rider, or Uno.
Cross-distribution namespace and glibc-host qualification remains pending.
nextDecision: Use the accepted hermetic path in installer staging and repeat the full authentic-Xcode root bootstrap gate.

redaction.notes: Exact input/output hashes, tool versions, command shapes, and bounded results are published without private paths.
